description: This file implements a HungarianMatcher class for computing optimal assignment between predicted objects and ground-truth targets in an object detection model. It includes methods for cost calculation based on classification, bounding box L1 distance, and GIoU, and a factory function for creating matcher instances from arguments.

classes.name: HungarianMatcher
classes.description: Computes an assignment between network predictions and ground-truth targets using the Hungarian algorithm, considering classification, bounding box, and GIoU costs.

methods.name: __init__(self, cost_class: float = 1, cost_bbox: float = 1, cost_giou: float = 1)
methods.description: Initializes the HungarianMatcher with specified weights for classification, bounding box, and GIoU costs.

methods.name: forward(self, outputs, targets)
methods.description: Performs the matching between predicted outputs and targets, returning index pairs for each batch element.
